scope: Eight current Health and Safety completion-unproved targets independently reviewed; four bounded direct decisions and four retained-unproved decisions.

methodology.runtime_boundary: Comparator evidence changes benchmark P3 mapping completion_credit only; product, runtime, browser, representative-task, release and overall-audit completion deltas remain zero.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Behavioural evidence only; no source, schema, UI, assets or wording is copied.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: Packet-order IDs joined by LF with no terminal LF, UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.evaluation_proof_rule: Packet-order evaluation objects; JSON sorted keys, compact separators; LF joined without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.source_registry_rule: Exact verified file objects sorted by path; JSON sorted keys, compact separators; LF joined without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.
methodology.source_path_rule: Source paths sorted lexicographically and joined by LF without terminal LF; UTF-8 without BOM.

evaluations.requirement: Bind a worker acknowledgement to the exact published procedure version with actor, time, replay control, signature/evidence and audit provenance.
evaluations.behavior: The acknowledgement panel invokes a permission-bound action that locks a published document, resolves its current published version, rejects or absorbs replay, and persists a unique person-version acknowledgement with time, signature/evidence and audit record.
evaluations.reason: Exact-version acknowledgement analogue only; no Oblivion workforce eligibility, Site, expiry, competency, runtime or browser parity.

evaluations.requirement: Download the authorised exact published procedure attachment with stable version identity, content disposition and access audit.
evaluations.behavior: Per-version PDF/DOCX links call a route that validates identifiers and permission/published visibility, resolves the exact version attachment, audits the access and streams it with Content-Disposition.
evaluations.reason: Exact-version download analogue only; no Oblivion attachment ownership, Site/direct-object, malware, retention, runtime or browser parity.

evaluations.requirement: Export an authorised, bounded and audit-recorded procedure register with safe CSV encoding and current review/status fields.
evaluations.behavior: The document-register export applies filters, ordering and a row cap, records an audit event, and returns title, key, category, status and review fields through a formula-injection-hardened RFC4180-style CSV utility.
evaluations.reason: Bounded register-export analogue only; no Oblivion Site/role, exact field, retention, runtime or browser parity.
Participants, discussion, decisions, action items and reviewed-document pins do not prove a consultation-specific downloadable artifact or governed generator.
Management-review persistence does not prove a worker-participation minutes artifact, type-specific download route or exact minutes provenance; generic document download is not inherited.
